id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data spec that will hold the the internal datasources for {@link UiSdlParallelCoordinatesChart}
which invokes fetchData.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

hiddenSeries.description: A list of hidden series id.

tooltipValuesDecimalPrecision.description: The decimal precision to show on tooltip values.

tooltipUnitEnabled.description: Whether or not to show units in tooltip

axesDataSpec.description: The specification used for defining the axes of the chart which invokes fetchAxes.

axes.description: Holds the data that defines the axes.

smoothLine.description: Defines if the chart series should be straight or smooth.

enableAxesDropdownList.description:
Set to true if you want to enable the axes dropdown list.
This allows showing/hiding with checkboxes as well as reordering of the axes.

invertedAxes.description: A list of indices of inverted axis.

colors.description:
An array of hex string colors to use for a group of series data.
May be overwritten if defined in metadata '#' prepended. e.g., #12ef3b.
This is specifically not the same colors as {@link UiSdlChartColorConfig#defaultColors}.
